## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm -r typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes
- [ ] `pnpm -r test` passes, and new behaviour has a test
- [ ] If `schema.json` changed: `types.ts` and its tests updated
- [ ] If the bridge protocol changed: `BRIDGE_PROTOCOL.md` updated
